caption:
Ever feel your prayers change nothing? Twice, one man's plea turned it back. (Amos 7:3 devotional)

God relented at a shepherd's plea; your prayer is never poured out in vain. Your prayer is not in vain.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 What have I stopped praying for, sure it makes no difference?
